name: Soft Body
concept: Large radii, soft shadows and barely-saturated pastels make dense data feel handled, not audited.

type.families: Neo-grotesque or rounded humanist (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, Nunito Sans). Slight roundness in the letterforms helps.
type.hierarchy: Page title 26/32 semibold · card title 16/22 semibold · figure 30/36 semibold · body 14/21 regular · chip 11/15 medium. Comfortable, never cramped.
type.usage: Sentence case throughout. Pastel chips carry dark ink of their own hue family, never white. Numbers get room to breathe — this style never crams a table.

tokens.texture: Depth comes from shadow, not borders. Cards are white with a 20-24px radius and `0 2px 8px rgb(19 28 51 / .06)`, optionally a hairline. The whole app often sits in a rounded shell (28px radius) inset in a tinted `--bg` field with 24-40px of margin. Charts are friendly: lollipop bars with circular caps, capsule-tracked bars, soft gradient fills.
tokens.layout: Roomy. 8px scale, 24px card padding, 20px gaps, 16-24px radius everywhere, 999px on pills and avatars. Nothing touches anything. Where Hairline Ledger fits 24 rows, this fits 8 — that is the trade and the point.

avoid_for: enterprise admin with hundreds of rows
brands needing a severe or technical tone

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as soft 3D render or rounded flat illustration.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- pale lavender-grey ground #E7E8F0
- rounded matte forms with large corner radii and no sharp edges
- pastel accent palette — mint, lilac, peach — plus one indigo #4A46D8
- soft diffused lighting with gentle contact shadows
- friendly geometric shapes, generous spacing between elements

NEGATIVE SPACE: Keep at least a third of the frame as empty tinted ground.

DO NOT INCLUDE: sharp corners, high contrast, dark backgrounds, neon, technical or industrial imagery, dense detail.
